question: Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi dancer Yamini Krishnamurthy was awarded which of the following awards in 2016?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Vibhushan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The** "Yamini school of Dance"** was established by **Yamini Krishnamurthy **in Delhi in **1990.**
 
• She has also produced a unique dancing programme for the **Doordarshan channel.**
 
• The critics gave her book **"A Passion for Dance"** positive reviews.
 
• Throughout her dance career, she received numerous honours, including the **Padma Shree (1968), Padma Bhushan (2001), and Padma Vibhushan (2016), **two of the highest civilian awards given out by the Indian Republic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• One of India's **first classical dancers **was Yamini Krishnamurthy.
 
• She has received training in both **Kuchipudi **and **Bharatanatyam**, two contrasting dancing styles.
 
• She was born in **Madanapalle**, Andhra Pradesh, on** December 20, 1940.**
 
• At** Chennai's Kalakshetra School of Dance, **Yamini Krishnamurthy studied **Bharatnatyam under Rukmini Devi Arundale. **
 
• Later, she received training from illustrious teachers like **Thanjavur Kittappa Pillai **and **Kanchipuram Ellappa Pillai.**
 
• Under the instruction of **Vedantam Lakshmi Narayana Shastri, Chinta Krishnamurthy, **and **Pasumarthy Venugopal Krishna Sharma, **she learned **Kuchipudi**.
